na sasitthakaṃ pattadhovanaṃ antaraghare chaḍḍessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

41886.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of pattanillehaka
41886.commentary: (VINa) pattanillehaka oṭṭhanillehakesu'pi es'eva nayo. tasmā ek'aṅguliyā'pi patto na nillehitabbo, ekaoṭṭho'pi jivhāya na nillehitabbo, oṭṭhamaṃsehi eva pana gahetvā anto pavesetuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: na pattanillehakaṃ bhuñjissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na pattanillehakaṃ bhuñjitabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca pattanillehakaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

tena bhikkhunā so patto bhikkhuparisāya nissajjitabbo, yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto, so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo, ayaṃ te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo'ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.

41889.commentary: (VINa) pattapariyāpannaṃ paṭiggahetabban'ti sace upajjhāyena bhikkhācāre yāguyā vā bhatte vā laddhe patto uṇho vā bhāriko vā hoti, attano pattaṃ tassa datvā so patto gahetabbo'ti attho.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu, ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattam'pi tathārūpehi lābhehi, apaṭivibhattabhogī hoti, sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattam'pi tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī hoti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī, ayam'pi dhammo sāraṇīyo.

41891.meaning1: bowl in hand; carrying a bowl

examples.text: sa pattapāṇi vicaranto, amūgo mūgasammato, appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya, dātāraṃ n'āvajāniyā.

41892.meaning1: ascetic who only eats almsfood from the bowl
41892.meaning2: ascetic who eats only from alms-bowl
41892.commentary: (VISM) dutiyabhājanassa paṭikkhittattā kevalaṃ ekasmiṃ'y'eva patte piṇḍo pattapiṇḍo. idāni pattapiṇḍagahaṇe pattapiṇḍasaññaṃ katvā pattapiṇḍo sīlam'assā'ti pattapiṇḍiko. tassa aṅgaṃ pattapiṇḍik'aṅgaṃ.

examples.text: mandattā momūhattā pattapiṇḍiko hoti, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato pattapiṇḍiko hoti, ummādā cittakkhepā pattapiṇḍiko hoti, vaṇṇitaṃ buddhehi buddhasāvakehī'ti pattapiṇḍiko hoti, appicchataṃ'y'eva nissāya santuṭṭhiṃ'y'eva nissāya sallekhaṃ'y'eva nissāya pavivekaṃ'y'eva nissāya idam'atthitaṃ'y'eva nissāya pattapiṇḍiko hoti.
ek'āsanik'aṅgaṃ pattapiṇḍik'aṅgaṃ khalupacchābhattik'aṅgaṃ āraññik'aṅgaṃ rukkhamūlik'aṅgaṃ abbhokāsik'aṅgaṃ sosānik'aṅgaṃ

41893.meaning2: practice of eating only from alms-bowl
41893.construction:
patta + piṇḍa + ika + aṅga
pattapiṇḍika + aṅga

examples.text: ek'āsanik'aṅgaṃ pattapiṇḍik'aṅgaṃ khalupacchābhattik'aṅgaṃ āraññik'aṅgaṃ rukkhamūlik'aṅgaṃ abbhokāsik'aṅgaṃ sosānik'aṅgaṃ

41894.meaningLit: discourse on eating only from the almsbowl

41896.commentary: (ITIa) tasmāpattapuṭass'eva palāsapuṭassa viya duggandha-sugandha-vatthu-saṃsaggena asādhusādhujanasannissayena ca.

examples.text: tasmā pattapuṭass'eva, ñatvā sampākam'attano, asante n'upaseveyya, sante seveyya paṇḍito, asanto nirayaṃ nenti, santo pāpenti suggatin'ti.
bhikkhuṃ pan'eva kulaṃ upagataṃ pūvehi vā manthehi vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahetabbā.
dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahetabbā'ti dvetayo pattapūrā paṭiggahetabbā.

41898.meaning1: could be reached; could be attained; could be found (by)
41898.meaning2: what should be gained, attained or reached

examples.text: gamanena na pattabbo, lokass'anto kudācanaṃ, na ca appatvā lok'antaṃ, dukkhā atthi pamocanaṃ.

āraddhavīriyo viharati, kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ, na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

41899.meaning1: with wings as vehicle; (comm) going by wing

examples.text: tato pakkhī'pi jānātha, pattayāne vihaṅ'game, liṅgaṃ jātimayaṃ tesaṃ, aññam'aññā hi jātiyo.
